hook.line: Just broke our record of SEO growth: 30 times the traffic in two weeks.
hook.visual: Plain bedroom selfie, face centred; black-box title at the top 'We grew a client's SEO/AEO traffic by 30 times in 2 weeks', one white word at a time below.

beats.what: Result stated in the top title and the first sentence at once
Jump cut; a search-performance dashboard with a rising line chart pops in over the left side as proof
Cut, title and chart gone: explains it is regular SEO work, just more articles and backlinks, faster
Cut to reason two: the client is in a hot niche with fast-growing search terms
Cut to the 'fun fact': non-English content ranks faster because it is less competitive
Final cut on the payoff: articles in the other language grow about a hundred times faster than English

why_it_works: A specific multiplier and timeframe (30x in 2 weeks) in the first line and title, backed by a real dashboard chart at 2.5 s
Calm, unpolished delivery reads as an honest report from someone doing the work, not a pitch
Ends on a surprising, saveable tip (other languages rank faster) that rewards watching to the end
weaknesses: Very quiet audio (-33 LUFS) and no music; easy to scroll past
Only one visual after 6 s; the rest is a static face for 37 s
No CTA, and the language tip is not tied back to what the viewer should do
for_robert: Put the proof chart on screen within 3 s of stating a result, then remove it; Fred could carry the chart in and drop it out of frame once the number is said.
